text.opengl: Give every vertex the bones that move it: `Vertex` gets the ids of up to four bones and their weights (as attributes 3 and 4), and `Model` reads them from assimp – a `BoneInfo` (id + offset matrix) per bone name in `m_BoneInfoMap`, filled by `ExtractBoneWeightForVertices`, which walks each `aiBone`'s weights and puts them into the vertices with `SetVertexBoneData`.
text.vulkan: Give every vertex the bones that move it: `Vertex` gets the ids of up to four bones and their weights (attributes 3 and 4, also declared in the vertex shader), and the model reads them from assimp – a `BoneInfo` (id + offset matrix) per bone name in `ourModel.m_BoneInfoMap`, filled by `ExtractBoneWeightForVertices`, which walks each `aiBone`'s weights and puts them into the vertices with `SetVertexBoneData`.
text.d3d12: Give every vertex the bones that move it: `Vertex` gets the ids of up to four bones and their weights (input elements `BLENDINDICES` and `BLENDWEIGHT`), and `Model` reads them from assimp – a `BoneInfo` (id + offset matrix) per bone name in `m_BoneInfoMap`, filled by `ExtractBoneWeightForVertices`, which walks each `aiBone`'s weights and puts them into the vertices with `SetVertexBoneData`.

hint.opengl: The ids are integers: `glVertexAttribIPointer(3, 4, GL_INT, sizeof(Vertex), (void*)offsetof(Vertex, m_BoneIDs));` (no "normalized" parameter). Start every vertex with ids -1 and weights 0 (`SetVertexBoneDataToDefault`); a bone's offset matrix is `ConvertMatrixToGLMFormat(mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mOffsetMatrix)`, and its weights are `mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mWeights[k]` (`mVertexId`, `mWeight`).

In `anim_model.vert`: `layout(location = 3) in ivec4 boneIds;` and `layout(location = 4) in vec4 weights;`. Start every vertex with ids -1 and weights 0 (`SetVertexBoneDataToDefault`); a bone's offset matrix is `ConvertMatrixToGLMFormat(mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mOffsetMatrix)`, its weights `mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mWeights[k]` (`mVertexId`, `mWeight`).

Start every vertex with ids -1 and weights 0 (`SetVertexBoneDataToDefault`); a bone's offset matrix is `ConvertMatrixToXMFormat(mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mOffsetMatrix)`, its weights `mesh->mBones[boneIndex]->mWeights[k]` (`mVertexId`, `mWeight`).

text.opengl: Write the Bone: the keyframes of one animation channel (`KeyPosition`, `KeyRotation`, `KeyScale` with their time stamps), read from an `aiNodeAnim` by `CreateBone`, and `UpdateBone`, which finds the two keys around a time, interpolates between them – `glm::mix` for positions and scales, `glm::slerp` for the rotations – and stores `translation * rotation * scale` as the bone's local transform.
text.vulkan: Write the Bone: the keyframes of one animation channel (`KeyPosition`, `KeyRotation`, `KeyScale` with their time stamps), read from an `aiNodeAnim` by `CreateBone`, and `UpdateBone`, which finds the two keys around a time, interpolates between them – `glm::mix` for positions and scales, `glm::slerp` for the rotations – and stores `translation * rotation * scale` as the bone's local transform.
text.d3d12: Write the Bone: the keyframes of one animation channel (`KeyPosition`, `KeyRotation`, `KeyScale` with their time stamps), read from an `aiNodeAnim` by `CreateBone`, and `UpdateBone`, which finds the two keys around a time, interpolates between them – `XMVectorLerp` for positions and scales, `XMQuaternionSlerp` for the rotations – and stores the bone's local transform: scale, then rotation, then translation (`scale * rotation * translation` with DirectXMath's row vectors – learnopengl's `translation * rotation * scale`).

hint.opengl: `GetPositionIndex` returns the first index whose *next* key is later than the time; `GetScaleFactor(last, next, time) = (time - last) / (next - last)`. A track with one key is that key's value. Quaternions from assimp: `glm::quat(w, x, y, z)` (`GetGLMQuat`); `glm::toMat4` needs `#define GLM_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL` and `<glm/gtx/quaternion.hpp>`.

text.opengl: Write the Animator: it holds the 100 final bone matrices and the animation's current time. `CalculateBoneTransform` walks the node tree from the root – a node's global transform is its parent's times its own (the bone's interpolated local transform when the node is animated) – and stores `global * offset` as each bone's final matrix; `UpdateAnimation` advances the time (in ticks, looping) and recalculates. Create an animator for the sway animation and, for now, calculate the bones once at time 0.
text.vulkan: Write the Animator: it holds the 100 final bone matrices and the animation's current time. `CalculateBoneTransform` walks the node tree from the root – a node's global transform is its parent's times its own (the bone's interpolated local transform when the node is animated) – and stores `global * offset` as each bone's final matrix; `UpdateAnimation` advances the time (in ticks, looping) and recalculates. Give the application an `Animator animator` for the sway animation and, for now, calculate the bones once at time 0.
text.d3d12: Write the Animator: it holds the 100 final bone matrices and the animation's current time. `CalculateBoneTransform` walks the node tree from the root – a node's global transform is its own (the bone's interpolated local transform when the node is animated) followed by its parent's (`nodeTransform * parentTransform`) – and stores `offset * globalTransformation` as each bone's final matrix; `UpdateAnimation` advances the time (in ticks, looping) and recalculates. Create an animator for the sway animation and, for now, calculate the bones once at time 0.

hint.opengl: `InitAnimator` fills `m_FinalBoneMatrices` with 100 `glm::mat4(1.0f)`. `m_CurrentTime += m_TicksPerSecond * dt; m_CurrentTime = fmod(m_CurrentTime, m_Duration);`, then `CalculateBoneTransform(animator, &animation->m_RootNode, glm::mat4(1.0f))`. The bone's id and offset come from `m_BoneInfoMap[nodeName]`. After creating it: `UpdateAnimation(animator, 0.0f);`.
hint.vulkan: `InitAnimator` fills `m_FinalBoneMatrices` with 100 `glm::mat4(1.0f)`. `m_CurrentTime += m_TicksPerSecond * dt; m_CurrentTime = fmod(m_CurrentTime, m_Duration);`, then `CalculateBoneTransform(animator, &animation->m_RootNode, glm::mat4(1.0f))`. The bone's id and offset come from `m_BoneInfoMap[nodeName]`. In `initVulkan()`: `InitAnimator(animator, &swayAnimation); UpdateAnimation(animator, 0.0f);`.
hint.d3d12: `InitAnimator` fills `m_FinalBoneMatrices` (`std::vector<XMFLOAT4X4>`) with 100 identities. `m_CurrentTime += m_TicksPerSecond * dt; m_CurrentTime = fmod(m_CurrentTime, m_Duration);`, then `CalculateBoneTransform(animator, &animation->m_RootNode, XMMatrixIdentity())`. The bone's id and offset come from `m_BoneInfoMap[nodeName]`. In `LoadAssets`: `InitAnimator(m_animator, &m_swayAnimation); UpdateAnimation(m_animator, 0.0f);`.

text.opengl: Skin the mesh in the vertex shader: take the bone ids (`ivec4`, location 3) and weights (location 4), and move each vertex to the weighted sum of `finalBonesMatrices[boneId] * position` over its bones (skipping ids of -1). Upload the animator's 100 matrices every frame.
text.vulkan: Skin the mesh in the vertex shader: move each vertex to the weighted sum of `finalBonesMatrices[boneId] * position` over its bones (skipping ids of -1). The 100 matrices go into the uniform buffer, copied from the animator every frame.
text.d3d12: Skin the mesh in the vertex shader: take the bone ids (`int4 boneIds : BLENDINDICES`) and weights (`float4 weights : BLENDWEIGHT`), and move each vertex to the weighted sum of where each of its bones puts it (skipping ids of -1). Put the animator's 100 matrices into the constant buffer every frame.

hint.opengl: `uniform mat4 finalBonesMatrices[MAX_BONES];` with `const int MAX_BONES = 100;`. In the loop: `auto transforms = animator.m_FinalBoneMatrices;` and `ourShader.setMat4("finalBonesMatrices[" + std::to_string(i) + "]", transforms[i]);` for every i.
hint.vulkan: In C++: `const int MAX_BONES = 100;` and `glm::mat4 finalBonesMatrices[MAX_BONES];` after `proj` in `UniformBufferObject`; in `updateUniformBuffer()`: `auto transforms = animator.m_FinalBoneMatrices;` and `ubo.finalBonesMatrices[i] = transforms[i];` for every i. In the shader the same member in the uniform block, `const int MAX_BONE_INFLUENCE = 4;`, and learnopengl's loop: `totalPosition += ubo.finalBonesMatrices[boneIds[i]] * vec4(pos, 1.0) * weights[i];`.
hint.d3d12: HLSL: `static const int MAX_BONES = 100; static const int MAX_BONE_INFLUENCE = 4;`, `float4x4 finalBonesMatrices[MAX_BONES];` in `SceneConstantBuffer`, `float4 localPosition = mul(float4(pos, 1.0f), finalBonesMatrices[boneIds[i]]); totalPosition += localPosition * weights[i];`. C++: `const int MAX_BONES = 100;`, `XMFLOAT4X4 finalBonesMatrices[MAX_BONES];` in `SceneConstantBuffer`, and in `OnUpdate` `XMStoreFloat4x4(&constantBufferData.finalBonesMatrices[i], XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&m_animator.m_FinalBoneMatrices[i])));` for every i.

text.opengl: Play the animation: advance it by `deltaTime` every frame (after the input), and drop the one-time update at time 0.
text.vulkan: Play the animation: advance it by `deltaTime` every frame (after the input), and drop the one-time update at time 0.
text.d3d12: Play the animation: advance it by `deltaTime` every frame in `OnUpdate` (after the input, before the constant buffer is filled), and drop the one-time update at time 0.

hint.opengl: `UpdateAnimation(animator, deltaTime);` in the render loop – learnopengl's `animator.UpdateAnimation(deltaTime)`.
